about_the_game:
"That Summer - Hannah's Summer Vacation" is an RPG game produced by 七十七 and published by Hanabi games.

Game Overview

Hannah is about to start a new semester. To gain more life experience and earn some pocket money, she decides to look for part-time jobs around town. Players can freely choose daily activities, explore different locations, and enjoy a relaxing yet fulfilling vacation life.

This game offers a high degree of freedom, allowing you to arrange your schedule at your own pace. With a variety of outfits to choose from, Xiaohan can appear in different styles. In addition, there are plenty of interactive elements and side events waiting to be discovered.

Game Features

  • Jrpg

  • High freedom of exploration

  • Part-time jobs and character growth elements

  • Outfit customization system

  • Rich interactive story events

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8/8.1/10
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8/8.1/10
  • Processor: 3+ GHz Processor
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
